g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud hybrid network with Dedicated Interconnect, HA VPN backup and hybrid DNS

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Traffic for the VPC goes to the data centre's edge routers
over Dedicated Interconnect links in two edge availability domains
Cloud Router learns the data centre's routes over BGP and advertises the VPC's
The request reaches the ERP internal load balancer
which spreads it over ERP VMs in two zones
The VMs use Cloud SQL over private services access
Data centre DNS forwards Google Cloud private zones to the inbound server policy
Cloud DNS answers, and a forwarding zone sends corp names back to the data centre
Backup servers send nightly backups across the Interconnect
to Cloud Storage through a Private Service Connect endpoint that Cloud Router advertises
If both Interconnect links fail, BGP moves traffic to HA VPN
